description.en: Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, is a constitutional monarchy located in the southern portion of the Indochina Peninsula in Southeast Asia. It borders Thailand to the northwest, Laos to the north, Vietnam to the east, and fronts the Gulf of Thailand to the southwest. Cambodia is the direct successor state to the mighty Khmer Empire, which ruled most of Indochina between the 11th and 14th centuries and left behind Angkor Wat, the world's largest religious monument. The country is characterized by an ethnically homogenous population, deep Theravada Buddhist devotion, and an economy driven by garment manufacturing, tourism, and real estate construction.
description.zh: Cambodia全稱為柬埔寨王國，是位於東南亞中南半島南部的君主立憲制國家。國土西北與泰國接壤，北部與寮國毗鄰，東部及東南部與越南交界，西南則面向泰國灣。柬埔寨是古代高棉帝國（Khmer Empire）的直接繼承國，該帝國曾在11至14世紀期間統治中南半島大部分地區，並留下了世界最大的宗教建築群吳哥窟。現代柬埔寨人口結構高度單一，以上座部佛教為國教，其經濟體制屬於高度美元化的開放市場，成衣加工外銷、跨國觀光旅遊、房地產營建與農業為其四大經濟支柱。

seoText.en: Discover comprehensive facts about Cambodia — population demographics, land area, capital city Phnom Penh, and detailed analyses. Explore Siem Reap's Angkor Wat temple complex, the Mekong River watershed, Tonlé Sap Lake fisheries, Sihanoukville SEZ development, the Cambodian Riel, and political transformations under the ruling party.
seoText.zh: 深入了解柬埔寨的基本資料：精確人口結構、國土面積、首都金邊與詳盡概述。探索暹粒吳哥窟考古園區、湄公河水文、洞里薩湖生態、西哈努克港（西港）經濟特區發展、瑞爾與美元雙幣制、紅色高棉歷史轉型，以及現行政黨政治趨勢。

list: Strategic coastal nation sitting along critical maritime routes in the Gulf of Thailand
Boasts an unmatched archaeological legacy derived from the medieval Khmer Empire
Sustains an open, highly dollarized market economy with exceptional GDP growth rates
Navigating postwar reconciliation while consolidating long-term political successions
en.text: Cambodia occupies a pivotal geographic depression in mainland Southeast Asia, positioned within the geopolitical orbit of major regional neighbors Thailand and Vietnam. Culturally integrated by the Khmer language and a shared spiritual history, the country has made immense strides in overcoming the catastrophic devastation wrought by the Khmer Rouge regime (1975–1979). Today, Phnom Penh operates as a rapidly verticalizing metropolitan center, driving the nation's transition into a low-middle-income industrial player connected heavily to global light manufacturing supply chains.

list: 中南半島南部戰略要衝，南臨泰國灣海權航道，具備優良深水港優勢
坐擁無與倫比的高棉帝國考古遺產，吳哥文明在東南亞歷史中獨樹一幟
實行高度開放、全亞洲罕見的「高度美元化」雙幣市場經濟體制
走出20世紀後期內戰陰霾，當前正經歷新一代政治領導體系的全面平穩交接
zh.text:
柬埔寨地處中南半島的核心盆地地帶，地緣上夾在泰國與越南兩大傳統東協強權之間。全境文化、語言與生活習慣高度統一。在成功走出20世紀70年代紅色高棉極端統治及隨後長期內戰的歷史創傷後，柬埔寨在聯合國主持和平大選後迎來了30餘年的穩定發展期。

首都金邊從一座戰後廢墟迅速翻轉為高樓林立的現代化金融與消費中心，帶領全國從傳統農業國度跨越為緊密對接全球輕工業供應鏈的新興製造業基地。

list: Characterized by a low-lying central alluvial plain encircled by low mountain ranges
The Mekong River bisects the country from north to south, serving as a vital waterway
Home to Tonlé Sap, the largest natural freshwater lake ecosystem in Southeast Asia
Flanked by the Cardamom Mountains in the southwest and the Dângrêk range in the north
en.text: Cambodia's topography is structured like a shallow bowl spanning 181,035 square kilometers. Over three-quarters of the country consists of flat sedimentary plains, which make the terrain ideal for intensive wet-rice cultivation. The hydro-geography is defined by a unique phenomenon: during the monsoon season, the swelling Mekong River reverses the flow of the Tonlé Sap River, pushing water backward into the Tonlé Sap Lake, expanding its surface area up to fivefold and turning it into one of the world's most productive inland freshwater fisheries.

list: 地形結構狀似巨大盆地，中央為廣闊低平的沖積平原，四周被丘陵與山脈環繞
湄公河由北向南縱貫全境，注入越南三角洲，是不可或缺的灌溉與航運動脈
坐擁東南亞最大的淡水湖泊——洞里薩湖（Tonlé Sap），具備獨特的「河水倒流」奇景
西南邊界為險峻的豆蔻山脈（Cardamom Mountains），北界則以扁擔山脈與泰國相隔
zh.text:
柬埔寨國土面積約 18.1 萬平方公里，地形特色極為鮮明。全國超過 75% 的土地屬於海拔低於 100 公尺的中央大平原，土質受河流泛濫沖積而極其肥沃，是高棉文明得以孕育萬代人口的稻作核心。

水文上的最大亮點是湄公河與洞里薩湖的季節性聯動：每年 5 月至 10 月雨季來臨時，湄公河水暴漲，強大的水壓會迫使洞里薩河「逆流」倒灌進湖泊，使湖泊面積從乾季的 2,500 平方公里急速膨脹至 1.2 萬平方公里以上。這種神奇的生態機制帶來了海量的有機泥沙與魚類資源，供應了全國超過七成的蛋白質來源。

list: Governed by a tropical monsoon climate with near-uniform hot temperatures year-round
The southwest monsoon brings the rainy season from May through October
The northeast monsoon delivers a dry, cooler winter interval from November to April
Prone to localized seasonal flooding along major low-lying river plains
en.text: Average temperatures in Cambodia stay warm year-round, ranging from 22°C in the cooler winter months up to 40°C in April ahead of the monsoons. The rainy season accounts for nearly 80% of the country's annual rainfall, which filling agricultural aquifers but occasionally causing severe logistics delays. The winter dry season provides ideal conditions for global travelers visiting archaeological landmarks.

list: 屬典型熱帶季風氣候，全年無冬，平均氣溫常年維持在 25°C 至 35°C 之間
每年 5 月至 10 月受西南季風影響進入雨季，空氣濕度高且午後常有雷陣雨
11 月至次年 4 月受東北季風主導進入乾季，降雨稀少，為黃金旅遊旺季
4 月通常為全年最酷熱的月份，氣溫常突破 38°C，全境普遍迎接新年祈雨
zh.text:
柬埔寨氣候深受熱帶海洋與大陸季風交替控制。雨季期間，西南季風挾帶泰國灣與印度洋的飽和雨量傾瀉而下，為農業水稻田提供了充足水源，但也會導致湄公河沿岸平原發生常態性局部水患。

乾季則呈現截然不同的清爽景象，特別是 11 月至 1 月期間，東北風帶來較為涼爽乾燥的空氣，夜間氣溫可降至 22°C 左右，是各國觀光客前往暹粒（Siem Reap）吳哥古蹟群進行戶外考察的最佳時機。

list: Total population stabilizes at approximately 17.4 million inhabitants
Maintains a highly ethnically homogenous structure with Khmer comprising 97.6% of people
Minority ethnic groups consist of Chams (1.2%), ethnic Chinese (0.1%), and Vietnamese (0.1%)
Boasts a distinct, youth-centric demographic curve with a median age of around 27
en.text: Cambodia features remarkable linguistic and cultural uniformity, with Khmer functioning as the official language spoken by over 95% of citizens. In terms of religion, Theravada Buddhism is the constitutional state religion, practiced by 97.1% of the population, woven into everyday social norms and legal laws. Islam is practiced by approximately 2% of the population, primarily within the ethnic Cham minority community. Christianity (0.3%) and traditional tribal animism in the northeastern highlands form the remaining minority faiths. Due to the tragic loss of life during the 1970s genocide, Cambodia possesses an exceptionally young population structure, providing a massive, highly competitive entry-level manufacturing labor force.

list: 全國總人口已達約 1,740 萬人，人口密度適中，主要集中於金邊與南部各省
族群結構在東南亞各國中顯著單一，主體高棉族（Khmer）高占總人口的 97.6%
少數民族群體包含：占族（約 1.2%）、華族（約 0.1%）以及越南族（約 0.1%）等
擁有一條極具活力的年輕化人口曲線，國民年齡中位數僅約 27 歲，勞動力充沛
zh.text:
根據柬埔寨規劃部統計局最新普查數據，柬埔寨的族群與宗教構成高度集中且穩定。具體精確數據如下：

民族組成：高棉族占總人口的 97.6%，是絕對的主體民族，官方語言高棉語（Khmer）通行全境。少數民族中，信奉伊斯蘭教的占族（Cham）約有 20 萬人（占 1.2%）；歷史悠久的柬埔寨華人（Chinese Khmer）在經濟界實力雄厚，約占 0.1% 左右；越南裔（Vietnamese）多沿著洞里薩湖及邊境水上村落群居，約占 0.1%；東北部山區（如臘塔納基里省）另有少數山地原住民（高棉原住民）。
宗教信仰分佈：上座部佛教（Theravada Buddhism）為憲法明定的國教，信徒占總人口的 97.1%，寺院（Wat）是社區生活的教育與福利核心；伊斯蘭教占總人口的 2.0%，主要為占族穆斯林社群；基督教各派信徒約占 0.3%；其餘則為山地部落的萬物有靈信仰。

由於20世紀70年代大清洗導致大量高年齡層人口喪生，戰後嬰兒潮使得如今柬埔寨30歲以下年輕人口過半，形成極為強大的人口紅利，也是吸引外資製造業進駐的關鍵籌碼。

list: Operates as an export-oriented frontier market with a unique dual-currency banking system
The garment, textile, and footwear (GFT) export trade accounts for the majority of industrial revenue
The US Dollar (USD) handles over 80% of urban commerce, paired with the domestic Khmer Riel
Sihanoukville (Kampong Som) hosts the nation's premier deep-sea container port and SEZ hub
en.text: Cambodia has been one of the world's fastest-growing economies over the past two decades. Its highly open investment codes allow 100% foreign corporate ownership across most sectors, making it a magnet for Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), particularly from China. Garment and footwear factories manufacture apparel under duty-free trade quotas for the European Union and US markets. Concurrently, the government is expanding its infrastructure by opening new international airports in Siem Reap and Phnom Penh, while promoting agro-processing exports like milled jasmine rice and premium cashews.

list: 外向型對外開放市場，實行亞洲少見的美元與瑞爾（Riel）雙軌並行貨幣機制
服裝、纺織品與鞋類加工外銷（GFT）是絕對的外匯支柱，創造百萬個就業機會
金融法規極具吸引力，允許外資100%持股且無外匯管制，吸引大量跨國直接投資（FDI）
西哈努克港（西港）深水港與配套經濟特區，承接了全國絕大多數的國際海運吞吐量
zh.text:
柬埔寨是近年亞洲經濟成長最亮眼的「亞洲小虎」之一。其金融環境具備極高特殊性：由於歷史因素，美元（USD）在金邊、西港等都市的商務、薪資結算與大額交易中占據 80% 以上的主導地位，本幣瑞爾（KHR）則多用於找零或基層農村交易，免除了跨國投資者的匯率轉兌風險。

柬埔寨政府積極推動租稅優惠，使其服飾、運動鞋與旅行箱製造業常年享受歐美給予的關稅減免。中資在此重倉投入基礎建設，包括開通「金邊—西港高速公路」並擴建西港特區。同時，農業結構正逐步精緻化，柬埔寨香米（Jasmine Rice）與腰果出口額已高居世界前列。

list: Constitutional monarchy with a multi-party system dominated by a singular ruling force
Executive political authority is directed by the Prime Minister and the ruling cabinet
The King (HM Norodom Sihamoni) functions as the unified symbol of national identity
Completed a historic generational political transition within the top executive leadership
en.text: The contemporary political landscape of Cambodia is characterized by strong stability under the Cambodian People's Party (CPP). Following decades of leadership under Hun Sen, a peaceful generational transition took place in late 2023, with Hun Manet assuming the office of Prime Minister. The new administration focuses on economic modernization through its 'Pentagonal Strategy', upgrading digital infrastructure and building closer diplomatic ties within ASEAN, while balancing economic relations with Western markets and strong strategic partnerships with Beijing.

list: 憲政君主立憲制國家，設有雙院制國會（國民議會與參議院），實質由單一政黨主導
行政權力高度集中於內閣總理（首相），主導國家日常治理與內外政策走向
現任國王諾羅敦·西哈莫尼（Norodom Sihamoni）為國家元首，不具備實質干政權力
2023年後期順利完成跨世代的權力交接，由留美背景的新一代菁英內閣全面接班
zh.text:
柬埔寨現代政治由柬埔寨人民黨（CPP）長期維持穩固控制。在強人洪森（Hun Sen）首相執政近40年後，內閣於2023年年底啟動了歷史性的新老交替，由其長子洪馬內（Hun Manet）將軍正式接任首相職務，大批具備歐美留學背景的少壯派技術官僚也陸續進入權力核心。

新政府上台後推出「五角戰略」，將施政重心轉向數位經濟轉型、提升行政效能與優化跨國投資環境。在外交上，柬埔寨在東協（ASEAN）內部堅持務實外交，在政治與戰略上與中國維持堅定不移的「鐵桿友誼」，同時在經貿層面積極修復與美、歐、日等西方核心出口市場的關係。

list: Social norms are heavily grounded in traditional Theravada Buddhist ethics and etiquette
Rapid economic expansion has elevated the urban middle class while expanding wealth gaps
Urbanization remains focused on the rapid sprawling of the Phnom Penh municipality
The youthful workforce shows high adaptability toward digital tech and mobile wallets
en.text: Cambodian social life revolves closely around family units and village temples (Wats), which act as community centers. Post-conflict generations have high digital connectivity, with mobile payment systems like Bakong transforming local finance. However, balancing fast urban enrichment with the infrastructural needs of rural smallholder rice farmers remains an important public policy objective.

list: 社會道德與人際交往深度依循佛教教義，民風普遍溫和、重視禮貌與長幼尊卑
經濟騰飛帶動了金邊等大都市中產階級的興起，但城鄉貧富差距依然清晰可見
都市化速度迅猛，大量農村青年遷往都市從事成衣製造、外送與服務業
年輕世代極具數位適應力，智慧型手機普及率高，全面跨越至行動支付時代
zh.text:
柬埔寨社會正處於傳統佛教農耕文化與現代消費主義的劇烈交織期。遍布全國的一萬多座佛寺不僅是宗教信仰中心，更是農村重要的知識傳播、孤兒收容與老人安養場所。隨著近年互聯網基礎建設普及，由柬埔寨央行推出的「巴孔」（Bakong）區塊鏈行動支付系統風靡全國，使柬埔寨在金融科技普及率上甚至超越部分已開發國家。

不過，由於都市房價飆升與外資湧入，金邊的白領奢華生活與邊遠省份（如柏威夏省）靠天吃飯的稻農生活形成了強烈對比，縮短教育與醫療資源的城鄉鴻溝是當前社會政策的重心。

list: Inheritor of the grand classical Khmer arts, classical ballet, and specialized stone reliefs
The monumental Angkorian temple ruins reflect advanced medieval hydraulic and engineering skills
Traditional dress like the Krama (plaid scarf) serves as a multi-functional national icon
Major holidays are synchronized with solar-lunar shifts, led by the Khmer New Year
en.text: Khmer cultural identity is anchored in the architectural achievements of the Angkor period (9th to 15th centuries). This classical legacy is visible in the intricate stone carvings of Apsara celestial dancers that decorate ancient stone walls, which also inspired the Royal Ballet of Cambodia. Traditional cuisine features unique flavor profiles driven by 'Prahok' (fermented fish paste) and delicate curries, reflecting a distinct maritime and riverine culinary heritage.

list: 承襲高棉帝國輝煌的古典藝術遺存，以精細的石雕、壁畫與宮廷舞劇聞名次大陸
吳哥窟（Angkor Wat）宏偉的布局，展現出中世紀超凡的幾何學與水利工程智慧
傳統格紋棉織水布「克羅馬」（Krama）用途廣泛，是極具代表性的高棉民族符號
文化節慶與水文、稻作密切掛鉤，以柬埔寨新年（Choul Chnam Thmey）與送水節最盛大
zh.text:
柬埔寨文化是南亞印度教文化與本土高棉信仰深度融合的結晶。世界文化遺產吳哥考古園區內的巴戎寺（Bayon），以其「高棉的微笑」四面佛巨型石雕震撼全球。這種古典美學至今仍流淌在柬埔寨人的血液中，例如被聯合國教科文組織列入無形文化遺產的「柬埔寨皇家芭蕾舞」，舞者透過精巧的手勢與曼妙的身段，再現古老神話中的阿普薩拉（Apsara）仙女。

日常服飾中，一條簡單的「克羅馬」水布可當圍巾、遮陽帽、包袱布甚至是嬰兒搖籃，展現了高棉人隨遇而安的智慧。飲食上則自成一格，善用醃魚醬（Prahok）調味，口味相較於鄰國泰國更溫和、更強調香草的原味。

list: Over-reliance on foreign capital and real estate assets increases exposure to external cycles
Combating cross-border telecom fraud networks operating in historical coastal enclaves
Protecting fragile forest reserves from illicit timber logging and illegal land concessions
Upgrading skills within the industrial workforce to move beyond low-wage assembly lines
en.text: Cambodia faces structural economic challenges as it seeks to diversify away from basic garment sewing into high-value electronics assembly and digital tech. Additionally, during the rapid transformation of coastal Sihanoukville, a weak enforcement environment enabled transnational cyber-scam syndicates to establish illegal operational bases. The government has since launched multi-ministerial crackdowns to completely dismantle these networks and restore the safety of its international tourism sector.

list: 經濟結構不夠多元，過度依賴外資引進與房地產開發，容易受全球景氣波動衝擊
沿海特定特區曾因治理真空滋生跨境電信詐騙園區，對國家國際形象造成嚴重干擾
經濟開發與生態保護的兩難，面臨熱帶珍貴林木非法盜採與湄公河流域生態退化壓力
勞動力技能轉型迫在眉睫，亟需提升職業教育以擺脫低利潤的初階成衣組裝階段
zh.text:
柬埔寨在高速成長中正迎來結構性瓶頸。在產業升級方面，隨著基本工資逐年上漲，柬埔寨必須在十年內將勞動力從單純的紡織剪裁，提升至電子零組件與高附加價值製造業。此外，在前幾年沿海城市西哈努克港（西港）的无序野蠻擴張中，由於法律監管滯後，導致跨國網賭與電信詐騙犯罪集團滲入，引發國際社會高度關注。

對此，柬埔寨政府近年重拳出擊，協同跨國警務聯手發動全境清剿，關閉非法園區並推動西港轉型為「多功能經濟特區」，力圖重塑國家安全的國際信譽並振興觀光產業。

list: Angkor Wat — The pinnacle architectural monument representing the sacred Mount Meru
The Royal Palace — The elegant Khmer-style royal residence located in central Phnom Penh
Bayon Temple — Famous for its dozens of massive, serene stone-carved faces
Preah Vihear — A mountain-top cliffside temple marking the northern border region
en.text: Cambodia's landmarks reflect its imperial architecture and natural features. Angkor Wat remains a globally recognized historical achievement, designed with advanced irrigation moats. Beyond Siem Reap, Phnom Penh's Royal Palace showcases golden Khmer roofs, while the cliffside temple of Preah Vihear offers panoramic views along the northern highlands.

list: 吳哥窟（Angkor Wat）—— 宏偉莊嚴的古代石砌神廟，象徵印度教神話中的宇宙中心須彌山
金邊皇宮（Royal Palace）—— 坐落於四臂灣畔的金色高棉傳統尖頂宮殿建築群，優雅神聖
巴戎寺（Bayon Temple）—— 位於大吳哥城中心，以54座塔面上雕刻的「高棉的微笑」聞名於世
柏威夏寺（Preah Vihear）—— 矗立於扁擔山脈525公尺懸崖峭壁之巔、俯瞰平原的古代聖殿
zh.text:
柬埔寨的歷史地標在世界考古界享有至高無上的崇敬。暹粒的吳哥古蹟考古園區不單是一座神廟，而是一座包含了複雜人工運河與蓄水池（東西大霸）的中世紀超大型城市遺址。金邊市區的皇家宮殿內附設有銀閣寺（Silver Pagoda），地板由數千塊純銀磚鋪就，彰顯王室歷史。

而列入世界文化遺產、位於泰柬邊境的柏威夏寺，其順應地形層層遞進的石砌軸線建築風格，被譽為古典高棉建築藝術的巔峰之作。

list: Active, core member of ASEAN and the wider Mekong-Lancang economic cooperation framework
Maintains an exceptionally strong strategic and economic alliance with mainland China
Secures critical industrial trade concessions via the RCEP agreement and bilateral FTAs
Balances complex, historically sensitive relations with bordering regional neighbors
en.text: Cambodia plays an active diplomatic role in mainland Southeast Asia. It balances close economic cooperation and infrastructure funding from China under the Belt and Road Initiative with regional ties within ASEAN. The country works to maintain good border trade with Vietnam and Thailand while participating in Mekong River water management frameworks.

list: 東協（ASEAN）的核心成員國，深度參與瀾滄江—湄公河合作（LMC）等次區域機制
與中國建有全面戰略合作夥伴關係，是中國在中南半島最重要的地緣戰略盟友之一
透過加入《區域全面經濟夥伴協定》（RCEP）與多國自貿協定，積極開拓多元外銷通路
與鄰國泰國、越南在維持密切邊境貿易的同時，亦需小心維護歷史遺留的邊界爭端平衡
zh.text:
柬埔寨在中南半島的地緣外交中展現出高度靈活的務實主義。柬埔寨是中國推動「一帶一路」戰略的重要支點，中資興建的「德崇扶南運河」（Techo Funan Canal）等世紀水利工程，旨在打通金邊直通內海的航道。這在加深中柬經濟緊密度的同時，也引發了鄰國越南的高度關注。

柬埔寨在東協內部一貫主張維護國家主權與不干涉內政原則。面對西方因民主政體議題施加的壓力，金邊政府正透過拓展與日本、韓國及中東國家的全面經濟合作，努力實行多元平衡的外交路線。

list: Bilateral economic interactions are managed via non-official B2B investment frameworks
Taiwanese textile and footwear corporations form a key part of Cambodia's manufacturing base
Phnom Penh hosts a significant commercial network of Taiwanese manufacturers and banks
Bilateral police forces cooperate pragmatically to disrupt transnational cyber-scam networks
en.text: Taiwan and Cambodia maintain active, unofficial economic and trade ties. Taiwanese entrepreneurs were among the earliest investors in Cambodia's post-war garment export boom, establishing large manufacturing bases around Phnom Penh. Taiwanese financial institutions maintain a visible presence in Cambodia's dollarized commercial banking sector, while cultural exchanges continue through non-profit medical missions and direct flights between Taipei and Phnom Penh.

list: 兩地關係嚴格界定於非官方範疇，商務往來與民間投資皆透過 B2B 與非政府管道進行
台商成衣、製鞋與包裝廠在柬埔寨設廠歷史悠久，是當地製造業出口的重要奠基者之一
台灣多家大型商業銀行在金邊設有分行或子行，深度參與柬埔寨高增長的非金控美元金融市場
近年兩地警政單位透過第三方管道展開務實情報協作，攜手打擊跨國電信詐騙犯罪
zh.text:
柬埔寨與台灣目前未設有官方官方代表機構，領事業務由鄰近的駐胡志明市辦事處兼轄，但民間與經貿層面的交流十分深厚。自20世紀90年代柬埔寨開放以來，第一批台商便進駐金邊周邊（如加華工業區），引進先進的管理模式與全球品牌訂單，至今台商依然是柬埔寨成衣與製鞋出口的重要中堅力量。

在金融領域，台灣的第一銀行、兆豐銀行、合作金庫以及國泰世華、玉山銀行等，在金邊佈局深入，極大便利了在地台商的資金調度。文化與人道層面，台灣的非政府組織（如知風草文教服務協會、義診團）長年在柬埔寨偏鄉從事偏鄉教育與義診，贏得基層民眾的友誼。近年隨著兩地攜手重拳打擊跨境網賭與非法人口販運，雙邊的商務考察與觀光直航正逐步重回健康、安全的互利常態。

list: The historical cradle of the Khmer civilization that defined medieval Indochina
Preserves Angkor Wat, a supreme masterpiece of global sacred stone architecture
A foundational Theravada Buddhist state where monastic wats anchor social life
Sustains an open economic framework driven by dollarized manufacturing and international trade
Possesses a youth-dominated demographic curve driving regional tech and consumer growth
en.text: Cambodia balances deep civilizational pride with rapid post-war industrial development, serving as a dynamic market economy and key historical centerpiece within the modern mainland Southeast Asian landscape.

list: 中南半島古典文明的重要發源地，其高棉歷史遺存深度形塑了東南亞早期版圖
完美守護著地球上最宏偉的石砌神廟古蹟——吳哥窟，象徵人類古代工程學的奇蹟
以上座部佛教為國家的靈魂歸宿，僧侶與寺院在大眾基層生活中扮演恆常的燈塔角色
推行高度開放與美元化並行的雙幣金融體系，在輕工業組裝與外銷市場中展現強勁活力
憑藉年富力強、充滿創新彈性的人口紅利，成為區域數位支付與基礎建設投資的新興熱土
zh.text: 柬埔寨是一個將輝煌的古典帝國記憶、沉重的近代歷史苦難，以及現代生機勃勃的發展野心完美交織在一起的奇特國度。它在狭小的平原腹地上，孕育出了令全世界屏息的吳哥文明，並在經歷了廢墟般的戰火洗禮後，展現出了令人驚嘆的經濟復甦與城市現代化奇蹟。隨著新生代菁英內閣的全面掌舵與大湄公河次區域一體化的深化，這片歷史悠久的高棉土地，正以更加開放、安全的姿態，在當代印太經貿的舞台上走出一條自信的蛻變之路。

value.en: Cambodian riel (KHR / ៛) & US Dollar (USD / $) extensively dual-circulated
value.zh: 柬埔寨瑞爾（KHR / 貨幣符號為 ៛）與 美元（USD / $）在市面上維持高美元化的雙幣並行流通

value.en: Khmer (Official language spoken by 95%+), English widely utilized in commerce, government, and tourism
value.zh: 高棉語（Khmer / 官方與絕對通用語言）；英語在跨國商務、外資銀行、高階行政與觀光服務業中被極為廣泛使用

quickFacts.label: Government
quickFacts.value: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy dominated by the CPP

text.en: Angkor Wat Archaeological Park — The architectural peak of classical Khmer civilization and a peerless global heritage site
text.zh: 吳哥窟考古園區（Angkor Wat）—— 列入聯合國世界文化遺產，古代高棉帝國遺留的萬塔石刻宮殿，人類石砌建築藝術的極致

text.en: Khmer Empire Historical Roots — One of Asia's most dominant classical civilizations, shaping the arts and hydrology of early Indochina
text.zh: 高棉帝國歷史底蘊—— 曾稱霸東南亞中南半島的古代強盛文明，其雕刻、運河水利工程與法律體系深刻影響了周邊鄰國的歷史演變

text.en: Tonlé Sap Reverse Flow — Southeast Asia's largest freshwater basin featuring an incredible seasonal reverse river flow mechanism
text.zh: 洞里薩湖倒灌奇景—— 東南亞最龐大的天然淡水生態調節池，雨季迎來湄公河水逆流倒灌，孕育出富饒的內陸淡水野生漁業

text.en: Global Apparel Hub — Driving national urban employment and massive foreign exchange through large scale garment and footwear assembly
text.zh: 成衣加工外銷重鎮—— 國家最核心的工業出口經濟動脈，承接大量歐美時尚連鎖品牌訂單，是製造業吸納農村青年就業的主渠道

text.en: Dollarized Market Openness — Facilitating seamless multinational business operations through unrestricted foreign exchange and US dollar banking
text.zh: 高度美元化雙幣體制—— 全亞洲極具特色的金融環境，美元流通率高且無外匯管制，大幅降低跨國投資的匯率風險與資金進出門檻
